evidence: Modifies src/wallet/test/coinselection_tests.cpp to ensure SRD coin selection tests properly exercise weight-based tie-breaking.
rationale: Corrects a unit test flaw where reverting SRD weight tie-breaking logic went undetected. PR #33223 accidentally passed 'utxo_pool' instead of 'mixed_weight_pool' and had too loose a weight threshold, leaving the coin selection tie-breaker unexercised by automated tests.
